result.Method of Attack: Cryptocurrency mining via a JavaScript wrapper around XMRig mining software that utilizes unused system resources such as CI/CD and web servers; miner functionality triggered from within another program, not standalone
result.Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via publishing malicious packages to NPM repository using automated creation of over 1,000 user accounts bypassing NPM 2FA with disposable email service mail.tm
Indicators of Compromise: Use of disposable email service mail.tm to bypass NPM 2FA
Hardcoded username 'cloudyboi12' and 'cute' usernames in package configuration files
